technical.summary: Long-term structure is bullish but price is below key moving averages with weak momentum confirmation; high volume spike lacks follow-through from momentum indicators.

fundamental.summary: RF shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 88 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and news data unavailable, limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (379.5) with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; yield curve normal but macro_score -3 signals deteriorating conditions despite distant earnings (88 days).

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with extreme market fear (VIX 379.5) creates a contrarian accumulation opportunity for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all key moving averages (9/21/50), momentum is weak (MACD bearish histogram, RSI not rising, OBV flat, CMF negative), no active strategy triggered, zero fundamental conviction, and FOMC in 2 days creates severe volatility risk that invalidates technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term technical structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend, Ichimoku) offers contrarian appeal in extreme fear regime, but price is below all key short-term moving averages with zero momentum confirmation and no fundamental conviction to justify entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days during VIX crisis (379.5) will trigger severe volatility; price below 9/21/50 EMAs with weak momentum means stop-loss will likely be hit before mean reversion completes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical weakness, fundamental void, and macro crisis override contrarian sentiment signal
decision.portfolio_note: Already 20 positions in Financials sector; adding RF increases concentration risk without offsetting conviction or fundamental support.
